onboarding.1.alt: A crusader wall and a rock-cut chamber in the sandstone at Wu'ayra Castle
onboarding.1.body: Swipe through places most itineraries skip — Wu'ayra Castle, the Neolithic terraces at Basta, the back route into Little Petra. Keep what you like; it lands straight in your trip.
onboarding.1.title: Curated journeys to hidden gems
onboarding.2.alt: Walkers dwarfed by the sandstone walls of the Siq at Petra
onboarding.2.body: Your picks become a timed itinerary with real travel legs between stops. Change the trip length and it rebuilds — anything that will not fit comes back with a reason.
onboarding.2.title: A day plan that respects the clock
onboarding.3.alt: Wadi Musa at dusk, its street lights on below the Petra massif
onboarding.3.body: Verified local guides and drivers, the price for your trip shown before you commit, and no haggling at the gate.
onboarding.3.title: Booked with people who live here
